Lurgan is one of the duergars stationed in the Decrepit Village in Act One.
“
Gekh's the talker, not me. Back off.
„
— Lurgan

Involvement

Act One

Lurgan is a member of  Gekh Coal's group that was tasked to retrieve  Sergeant Thrinn's stolen boots. Lurgan is not interested in socializing and instead delegates all chatter to Gekh. He can be exposed from hiding on the platform above the central webbing east of Gekh.
